tools.name: archive_claim_documents
tools.description: Reads the list of documents attached to a closed claim and moves the files from the active claims folder into the archive folder. Returns the archived file names.

params.name: claim_number
params.description: Claim number whose documents should be archived

tools.code:
import shutil
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing
from pathlib import Path

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("claims-documents")

_DB_PATH = "claims.db"
_ACTIVE = Path("/srv/claims/active")
_ARCHIVE = Path("/srv/claims/archive")


@mcp.tool()
def archive_claim_documents(claim_number: str) -> list[str]:
    target = _ARCHIVE / claim_number
    target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    moved = []
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(_DB_PATH)) as conn:
        rows = conn.execute(
            "SELECT filename FROM claim_documents WHERE claim_number = ?",
            (claim_number,),
        ).fetchall()
    for (filename,) in rows:
        src = _ACTIVE / claim_number / filename
        if src.exists():
            shutil.move(str(src), str(target / filename))
            moved.append(filename)
    return moved

tools.name: run_settlement_payout
tools.description: Runs the settlement payout script for an approved claim and pays the settlement amount to the claimant through the payments API. Returns a summary with the script exit code and the transfer ID.

params.name: payee_account
params.description: Connected account ID of the claimant

tools.code:
import subprocess

import stripe

_SCRIPT = "/opt/claims/scripts/finalize_settlement.sh"


def run_settlement_payout(claim_number: str, amount_cents: int, payee_account: str) -> dict:
    result = {"claim_number": claim_number, "ok": False}
    if amount_cents <= 0:
        result["error"] = "amount_cents must be positive"
        return result
    transfer = stripe.Transfer.create(
        amount=amount_cents,
        currency="usd",
        destination=payee_account,
        metadata={"claim_number": claim_number},
    )
    result["transfer_id"] = transfer.id
    result["amount_cents"] = amount_cents
    proc = subprocess.run(
        [_SCRIPT, claim_number, transfer.id],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=120,
    )
    result["exit_code"] = proc.returncode
    result["stdout"] = proc.stdout.strip()
    result["stderr"] = proc.stderr.strip()
    result["ok"] = proc.returncode == 0
    return result
